📦 Compatibility
`dsh-pstack` ports pstack to DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It includes the upstream skills, playbooks, and
references, and adds skill routing, role-based model configuration, and role-routed subagents.
See the capability audit (in Chinese) and runtime mapping for the full porting review.
The current review covers 68 Cursor-facing capabilities: 39 direct mappings, 2 official plugins, 16
plugin implementations, and 11 deliberate omissions.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Requires DSH `>=0.2.2-rc.1` and Node.js `>=24.21.1`. See the script registry (in Ch
inese) for the extra runtime requirements of bundled workflows.

## 🧭 Usage
Choose one of the two paths and expand it for the complete steps.
🖥️ Visual setup
Use the plugin UI when you want to configure related plugins and role routes.
1. Open **Plugins → Installed plugins**, select **pstack**, then click **Configure**.
2. In **Recommended plugins**, review the **Recommended**, **Optional**, and **Conflicts** groups. *
*Enable all** only enables plugins in the **Recommended** group.
3. Open **Role models**, set the provider, model, and reasoning effort for each role, then save the
changed row or use **Save all**.
4. Open **Settings → Agent presets**, select **Poteto mode** or **Poteto Creator mode**, and click *
→ Agent presets**, select **Poteto mode** or **Poteto Creator mode**, and click **Set as default**.
5. When creating a Session, keep the default preset or select **Poteto mode** manually.
🧠 Skill usage
Use pstack skills when you want to start workflows directly from a Session.
1. **Initialize role routes.** Run `/setup-pstack` once. It writes the detected routes to `$DSH_HOME

/pstack-models.mdc`. Without this file, roles inherit the parent model.
2. **Start through skills.**

Type `/poteto-mode` directly. A preset switch is not required first.
3. **Use targeted commands.**
Pick a command from Common commands.

ties plus the persistent `poteto-mode` workflow. |

ndles read-only comment review and reports deletion targets and `MUST KILL` symbols. |
| `readonly`
| Child | Provides sandbox-enforced read-only research for inspection and evidence gathering. |

Electron interface and capture visual or accessibility evidence. |

ive an interactive CLI or TUI and capture terminal transcripts or performance evidence. |

n-write` | `authored` | Record a design choice, its rationale, and its implementation evidence throu
